coverage_assessment: Open-web first pass: 19 captured German- and English-language invocations covering national/regional outlets and searches across Vienna, Linz, Innsbruck and other Länder/cities, with climate, energy-price and labor leads. Verified event reporting is uneven and concentrated in Vienna; no LexisNexis-equivalent archive access, no comprehensive provincial or sectoral coverage, and several search-only/technical-failure leads remain. This is not exhaustive and does not imply that no other gatherings occurred. A focused coding check leaves the Fairdenken event pending because its announced agenda is not event-day verified; the sparse Vienna energy-price and A4-area leads remain pending evidence because attendance and event-specific domestic-target support are incomplete. Reported E003/E004 end dates apply only to those roadway actions.

query_capture_integrity.notes: Q001–Q019 retain the actual ordered refs, raw URLs and titles; Q018–Q019 are recovered original invocations, not repeated queries.
